name: Fujino Mitsuki
source:
An honor student with long brown hair.

She has a somewhat shy personality, but is blessed with stunning good looks and is always worried about those around her.

She takes on a rather rude attitude towards Yuusuke, in order to hide her embarrassment.

[Taken and translated from the [url=http://www.spermation.net/seacoxx/zombie/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
